artifact_observations.reasoning: The people in the foreground exhibit extreme motion blur or 'smearing' artifacts. While this may be intentional for privacy or due to camera shake, in the context of AI generation, this often represents a failure to render complex anatomy correctly, resulting in melted or fused forms.
The white foam of the waves lacks fine, crisp detail and appears slightly 'painted' or smudged rather than having distinct droplet structures typical of high-resolution photography.

There is an indistinct object/figure on the far right foreground that blends into the ground and background without clear boundaries, suggesting a generation artifact where the model failed to separate the subject from the environment.
